reason: The hexagonal cell is strongly indexed (all first 24 lines; DICVOL M(24)=132.9), and both CIFs parse as full-occupancy Na4V8O20 (Z=4, 32 atoms) in the same primitive P cell, with species-aware detected symmetries P63/mmc for selected and P-62c for alternative-1. However, neither submitted realization is chemically valid. The primary has periodic V-V contacts of 0.174 and 0.546 angstrom, O-O contacts of 0.278 and 0.578 angstrom, Na-O contacts of 0.758 angstrom, and no normal V-O first shell (nearest V-O about 3.10 angstrom). The alternative still has 0.897 angstrom Na-V and 0.966 angstrom V-O contacts and fails bond-valence assignment. These are pervasive instantiated-model failures, not preferences about coordination or density. The reported 0.996/0.986 correlations are stick-height comparisons obtained by sampling the observed profile at calculated line positions, not a comparable whole-profile refinement (the supplied comparable report is unavailable), and cannot rescue the overlaps. Thus the submitted set contains no sufficiently established viable ordered realization, while the blind evidence does not identify a specific viable replacement branch.
